title: Configuration encoding
statement: For a machine, natural numbers $n,s$, a Boolean list $x$, and a configuration $c$ on input $x$, define its Boolean code by concatenating: the first $n$ input bits, using false for positions beyond the end of $x$; the one-hot encoding of the input-head position among $n+2$ positions; the one-hot encoding of the state, including the optional halting state; the three work-tape flags for each of the machine's tapes and each position indexed from $0$ through $2s$; and the two flags indicating whether the output summary is acceptance or deadness.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the given machine on input $x$
